newsitem.title: USA: Bank forecloses on Idan unit assets.
newsitem.headline: Bank forecloses on Idan unit assets.

text.p: Idan Software Industries-I.S.I. Ltd said on Tuesday Greyrock Business Credit has foreclosed upon substantially all the assets of Idan's majority-owned subsidiary ASP Computer Products Inc and has sold those assets to a third party.

As previously announced, during the fiscal quarter ended September 30, Idan said it wrote off the entire value of its equity investment in ASP and is no longer consolidating ASP financial results. ASP had defaulted in its obligations under the revolving credit facility provided by Greyrock, Idan said.
As of December 19, the total principal and accrued interest owed by ASP to Greyrock was $710,000, Idan said.

As a result of the foreclosure, Idan said it continued to hold about $580,000 principal amount of unsecured subordinated notes issued by ASP. The company said there was no assurance Idan would able to collect any amounts due under these notes.
Idan also said its 75 percent owned unit Elitec Industries 77 Ltd declared a dividend of NIS 1.50 (US$ 0.46) per ordinary share to all holders of record on January 5, 1997.
